method: breaths by loudness (under -17 dB for 0.25 s, phrases under 1.5 s merged) + text alignment; Whisper: 9 of 12 breaks heard

lines.english: hail, O Lady of the Angels;
hail, thou root, hail, thou gate,

lines.latin: Ex qua mundo lux est orta:
lines.english: from whom unto the world a light hath arisen.

lines.latin: Vale, o valde decóra, Et pro nobis Christum exóra.
lines.english: farewell, O most beautiful, and pray for us to Christ.

lines.latin: Dignáre me laudáre te Virgo sacráta.
lines.english: Vouchsafe that I may praise thee, O sacred Virgin.

lines.latin: Da mihi virtútem contra hostes tuos.
lines.english: Give me strength against thine enemies.

lines.latin: Concéde, miséricors Deus, fragilitáti nostræ præsídium: ut qui sanctæ Dei Genitrícis memóriam ágimus, intercessiónis ejus auxílio a nostris iniquitátibus resurgámus.
lines.english: Grant, O merciful God, to our weak natures Thy protection, that we who commemorate the holy Mother of God may, by the help of her intercession, rise again from our iniquities.
Through the same Christ our Lord.
